descriptions.notStarted: The moment you reach Level 31, you receive a message from #b#p1002104##k. Is it about a new Informant Assignment? But he's never mentioned anything about it before…
descriptions.inProgress: #p1002104# says he has an urgent message for you and asks you to come to #b#m104000004##k right away. You wonder what's going on.
descriptions.completed: So it turned out that the message was from a fake #p1002104# who belongs to the Black Wings. In other words, the whole thing was a trap laid by the puppeteer to throw you off guard. Luckily, you were able to defeat the puppeteer, but he got away at the last second again. Meanwhile, #p1002104# was ambushed while waiting for a skill from #p1201000# to arrive. Luckily, he kept it safe and gave you the #bCombo Mastery#k skill.
